text: Given valid credentials, When teramind_list_computers is called, Then it returns the tenant's computer inventory as a non-empty list of {id, name, online} records (mocked upstream)
Given a mocked upstream response with more rows than the default limit, When teramind_list_computers is called without an explicit limit, Then exactly limit rows are returned and has_more is true

Given a computer id from the mocked inventory, When teramind_get_computer is called with it, Then the full computer record is returned; When called with an id the mocked upstream does not have, Then not_found is returned

Given valid credentials, When teramind_list_agents is called, Then it returns the user/agent inventory; When teramind_get_agent is called with an id from that list, Then that agent's detail record is returned
Given a valid period_start and period_end, When teramind_list_alerts is called, Then it returns the alerts raised in that window, each with rule_id, agent, computer and timestamp
Given period_start is missing, When teramind_list_alerts is called, Then invalid_argument is returned and no upstream request is made
Given rule_ids from a prior list_alerts result, When teramind_describe_alert_rules is called with them, Then a name/description is returned for each id

Given valid credentials, When teramind_list_behavior_policies, teramind_get_behavior_policy, teramind_list_behavior_groups, and teramind_list_anomaly_rules are each called, Then each returns its corresponding mocked structure without error
Given no X-Teramind-Access-Token header, When any tool is called, Then the call returns 401 with a body listing both required headers
Given X-Teramind-Instance is not a *.teramind.co host (e.g. evil.example.com), When any tool is called, Then invalid_argument is returned and zero outbound requests are made to the disallowed host
Given the mocked upstream returns 503, When any tool is called, Then upstream_error is returned with retryable true, not an unhandled exception

Given the mocked upstream returns 429 with Retry-After then succeeds, When a tool is called, Then the client retries and returns the normal result; Given 429 on every attempt, Then rate_limited is returned

Given two concurrent tools/call requests carrying two different tenants' instance/token headers against distinct mocked upstream hosts, When both are in flight at the same time, Then neither request's response or logs contain the other tenant's instance, token, or data
Given a real Teramind test account, When initialize -> tools/list -> tools/call is run against the live API for each of the 10 tools, Then the live response shapes match the documented contract
steps: Obtain a real Teramind instance host and access token from a test/trial account
Run `initialize`, then `tools/list`, confirm 10 tools are advertised
Call each of the 10 tools once against the live API with the real credentials
Compare each response's field names/types against docs/tickets/PRD-21246.md Data & API contract
expect: All 10 tools return 200-equivalent MCP results whose fields match the documented contract, or documented discrepancies are filed as a follow-up
evidence: needs a real vendor account — none available at design time; does not block 6b per vendor-mcp completion standard (no test account is not a blocker)
